source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape with pale blue-green and ocher washes: craggy mountains at left, misty winding water through the middle, tree groves, small roofed pavilions and village houses, rocky foreground banks, a distant bridge and tiny figure at lower right. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: left_craggy_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the large left-side mountain and cliff formation, including the tall vertical pale green-blue cliffs, ocher shaded facets, jagged upper peaks, ledges, sparse scrub dots, and dark contour cracks. Exclude calligraphy/seals above and exclude the lower village houses where possible.
must_preserve: angular cliff silhouettes and stepped ledges
pale mineral green-blue wash with warm ocher shading
dark ink contour lines and vertical texture strokes
small blue-green moss dots and black rock pitting
sparse leafless tree strokes clinging to cliff bases

motifs.name: central_peak_terrace_with_small_hut
motifs.description: Isolate the compact rocky terrace near the upper center-left with layered boulders, a small tucked roofed structure or shelter, and thin trees rising between the rocks.
must_preserve: small tan roof tucked against the rocks
stacked rock planes with blue-green washes
fine ink outlines and pebble-like moss dots
thin vertical tree trunks and dry twig brushwork
ocher shadows on ledges and crevices

motifs.name: misty_meandering_water_band
motifs.description: Isolate the pale winding water or mist channel that snakes from the left middle, through the central valley, and toward the right, including the curling shoreline lines and cloud-like edges. Exclude houses, trees, and mountain bodies except minimal edge contact needed for the water contours.
must_preserve: soft unpainted white water/mist reserves
thin tan and gray contour lines forming ripples and eddies
sinuous S-curves around islands and banks
delicate feathered wash transitions at the edges
small separated pools and looped water outlines

motifs.name: central_pavilions_in_forest
motifs.description: Isolate the middle-distance pavilion group set among a dense stand of slender trees beside the water, including the main pale roofed pavilion, smaller right pavilion, tree trunks, and immediate bank.
must_preserve: rectangular pale roofs with clean ink roof geometry
light peach and gray wall accents
closely spaced vertical tree trunks around the buildings
fine branch and needle strokes above the roofs
misty water edges at the base without including the whole river

motifs.name: left_foreground_village_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left hamlet embedded in rocks: low roofed houses, fences or wall lines, surrounding boulders, and adjacent clustered trees. Avoid including the large mountain mass behind except the immediate rocks enclosing the buildings.
must_preserve: low ocher roofs and pale wall panels
straight architectural linework for eaves and posts
rounded blue-green foreground rocks with dotted moss
mixed trees with bare branches, dark needles, and light foliage
soft washes linking houses to the rocky slope

motifs.name: tall_foreground_pine_and_bamboo_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the prominent central foreground grove with tall dark pines or bamboo-like trunks, drooping needle clusters, lighter deciduous foliage, and the rocky base beneath them.
must_preserve: tall slender trunks in dark brown and ink
black drooping pine needle clusters
pale dotted deciduous foliage masses
overlapping fine branch linework
blue-green rocks and moss dots at the roots

motifs.name: right_hillside_house_and_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the right middle-ground hillside with the long roofed house, nearby tall pines, sparse grove, rounded hills, and the stream bank below. Exclude red seals along the right margin.
must_preserve: long pale building with ocher roof and fine eave lines
vertical pine trunks and dark needle tufts
rounded green hills with ocher ridges
blue-green rock dots and short texture strokes
thin shoreline contour where the hill meets the water

motifs.name: lower_right_bridge_scholar_and_willow
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right scene with the tiny standing scholar figure on or near a small bridge, the simple bridge planks, adjacent drooping willow-like tree, and the immediate rocky bank and water lines.
must_preserve: tiny robed figure rendered with minimal ink strokes
simple narrow bridge with pale posts or plank lines
drooping willow branches and fine twig network
low blue-green rocks with dotted moss along the bank
faint water ripples and open misty space around the bridge

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
